scientific_scope: Self-contained offline reproduction from declared retained inputs. Includes fixed-task rankings, independent RNA, guide diagnostics, program nomination, native rvalues fitting materials and optional PertRank-Q checkpoint inference. Numerical replay, native fitting, checkpoint inference and source-table rendering are reported separately.

exit_codes.0: All selected commands completed with no explicitly partial native status. Consult declared scope and native reports for reproduction level.
exit_codes.1: Setup, integrity, execution, invalid/missing receipt or numerical verification failure.
exit_codes.2: Partial coverage, missing inputs, stored-result-only task, timeout or interruption.

modules.name: fixed_tasks
modules.scope: Existing retained four-donor ranking/depth, D4 supplement and Stim, independent RNA, interactions and external-baseline replay. Native model fits and raw-cell preprocessing are not rerun.

modules.name: early_intermediates
modules.reproduction_level: Saved-query score/block to original statistical summary replay
modules.scope: Recomputes the supplied four-source, factorial and early-study statistics from retained intermediate scores and bootstrap definitions. Original raw inputs, effects, reliability weights and candidate rankings are not reconstructed; archival-only items retain their identity.

modules.name: corrected_intermediates
modules.reproduction_level: Saved intermediate quantities to corrected-evidence statistical comparisons
modules.scope: Corrected guide and RNA evidence summary replay from retained intermediate arrays; the native report specifies recomputed contrasts and omitted upstream stages.

modules.name: r20_intermediates
modules.reproduction_level: Saved per-query scores to original within-screen and independent-RNA statistics
modules.scope: Five within-screen and two external-reference input groups per donor; original block definitions and bootstrap statistics. Does not reconstruct moments, predictions or raw CSR aggregation.

modules.name: paper_analysis
modules.reproduction_level: Mechanism, intervention-strata, query-transfer and application numerical replay
modules.scope: Retained analysis inputs reconstruct S3 decomposition, biological strata, transfer, TRADE sensitivity and CTLA4 application. Current manuscript figures are rendered by current_paper.

modules.name: il2_intermediates
modules.reproduction_level: Fixed guide/MAGeCK readout scores to original primary and secondary comparisons
modules.scope: All 561 candidates and ten fixed top-25 lists; reconstruct target medians, original 20,000 paired guide/control draws, intervals and MAGeCK support comparisons. Eligibility remains fixed and no raw counts or model fitting are used.

modules.name: sensitivity_replay
modules.reproduction_level: Saved-draw summary and fixed-coefficient numerical reconstruction
modules.scope: Four archived sensitivity draw groups and Mixscale fixed-coefficient scores/intervals; preserves the existing definitions and does not refit coefficients.

modules.name: current_paper
modules.reproduction_level: Independent-RNA four-arm ranking replay, guide diagnostic replay, current source-table figure rendering
modules.scope: Uses retained projected effects, reference draws, guide statistics and fixed predictions. Does not recreate raw cells or refit estimators. Figure output is separately identified as rendering from source tables.

modules.name: software
modules.reproduction_level: Optional software tests and tutorial smoke tests
modules.scope: Requires a separate environment with modules/paper_analysis/software[test] installed. This verifies the software interface; it does not add biological validation.

modules.name: pertrank_q
modules.reproduction_level: Frozen-checkpoint inference and original query-block statistical replay
modules.scope: PertRank-Q/B2 retained model predictions, candidate-subpool rankings and conditional paired intervals. Starts from retained model inputs and selected checkpoints, not raw cells; training is not run. Requires optional Torch dependency. Failure and exploratory arms retain their analysis identities.

modules.name: sn4_diagnostics
modules.scope: SN4.2–SN4.4 definitions, bins, support rates, original target bootstrap and recovered A10 summaries; no raw-cell projections or reranking.

modules.name: rvalues_native
modules.reproduction_level: Original native-fitting material verification and preparation
modules.scope: Restores and verifies complete native rvalues inputs and scripts for optional R fitting. The preparation command does not run the fits.

modules.name: new_results
modules.reproduction_level: Lossless retained-input reconstruction and numerical recomputation
modules.scope: Fixed rvalues memberships to five-task scoring and intervals; D3 program mechanism and sci-Plex3 frozen evaluation from retained moments, native outputs and reference projections. Recomputes weights, lists, utility, resampling and exact replacement accounting. No native model fitting.

modules.name: new_results_exploratory
modules.reproduction_level: Lossless retained-input reconstruction and numerical recomputation
modules.scope: Original exploratory ASH geometry adjustments, including unsuccessful branches, from retained statistics and fixed ASH outputs. Recomputes original comparisons without changing the frozen validation or selecting a new model.
